target_definition: conservative episode onset in (t0, t0+24h] after confirmed non-alarm on same channel
snapshot_grid: 78 objects × 4 snapshots/day across the available calendar period; dates with no records remain in the grid
cross_split_purge_policy: A supervised snapshot is retained only when its complete 24h target horizon stays within the same temporal split role. Features may use past events across split boundaries.
whole_day_no_records_policy: Conservative modeling policy for ambiguous dates with no records; not customer-confirmed technical data loss. Any 24h target horizon intersecting such a date is unknown and excluded from supervised splits.
target_end_of_data_policy: Any 24h horizon beyond the available 2026 registered-timestamp dataset is unknown and excluded from supervised splits.
unmatched_historical_channels: excluded from object model and retained only in source audit
timestamp_semantics: source registration timestamp; network delay/backfill and physical event time are not modeled

organizer_state_reference_contract.phase1_effect: Documentation/reference semantics only; source тревожное remains canonical and frozen Phase 1 features, targets, and 87-feature model contract are unchanged.
organizer_state_reference_contract.ambiguous_mapping_policy: Fail closed when the sensor-type/state-name key is missing or maps to conflicting alarm flags; do not infer from channel ID or physical meaning.

diagnostic_stage.scan_scope: exhaustive filter over all eight canonical processed Parquet partitions
diagnostic_stage.physical_semantics: neutral diagnostic features only; no thresholds or physical units inferred

behavioral_future_feature_test: passed: adding events strictly after t0 changed the target from 0 to 1 while all feature columns at t0 remained identical
target_sanity_scope: materialized snapshot parquet plus existing annual channel-hour parquet; no raw scan

phase2_evaluation.user_facing: merge repeated positive object forecasts into user-facing forecast episodes/cards
